g.text: #checkAccess(u : UserId, r : ItemId, acc : AccessType) : void
Common base of the services that receive a UserId.
Loads the User through IUserRepository and asks
AccessPolicy. It depends on abstractions, not on another
service. If access is denied it throws AccessDenied.

execute() calls process() and, if it returns
true, moves on to the next one (Template Method).
ExtractionStep creates the MediaFile with its
fingerprint and metadata; DuplicatesStep stops the chain
if the policy says REJECT; IndexingStep calls
CatalogIndex.ingest(). The chain is built by
+tagFile(u : UserId, id : ItemId, e : Tag) : void
the event bus (EventBusAdapter) is the only
owner of the observer list. CompositionRoot
registers this observer at startup. For each
CatalogEvent it writes to IChangeLog, which
SyncService reads from. Neither knows the other.
